sources.title: Ocean Waves on a Tropical Beach
sources.author: Jarrod Stanley
sources.notes: Full file, 44.1kHz stereo Ogg, 384.3s. Steady tropical ocean waves (RMS -10 to -12 dB in every 10s window checked, 0-310s); spectrally broad and low (centroid ~494 Hz, energy 50-1000 Hz), no narrow tones, no voices/music. Hot mastering (decoded peaks +2.1 to +2.7 dBFS) — gained down hard in the mix, so no clipping is introduced by the pipeline. Da Nang bed, slice 60-150s.
